ITEM 1 | Scrambled egg mass, bright yellow with pale yellow edges and small curds, soft and slightly moist, crumbly loose clumps spread across the upper left of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and about 1.5 cm thick at the thickest point, no visible browning | 90
ITEM 2 | Cubed red fruit, bright red-pink with pale flesh-like edges, moist and juicy surface, cut into irregular cubes about 2.5 cm per side scattered in the upper right, sitting on the plate with no sauce | 85
ITEM 3 | Brown glazed meat pieces, dark reddish-brown with a glossy sheen, roughly spherical bite-sized pieces about 2.5 cm in diameter, some with slightly charred or caramelized surface, clustered together in the lower centre of the plate | 120
